articles.title_en: Systematic default and return predictability in the stock and bond markets
articles.title_cn: 股票与债券市场中的系统性违约与收益可预测性
articles.abstract_en: We construct a measure of systematic default defined as the probability that many firms default at the same time. We account for correlations in defaults between firms through exposures to common shocks. Systematic default spikes during recessions, is correlated with macroeconomic indicators, and predicts future realized defaults. More importantly, it predicts future equity and corporate bond index returns both in- and out-of-sample. Finally, we find that the cross-section of average stock returns is related to firm-level exposures to systematic default risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个系统性违约的度量指标，定义为许多企业同时违约的概率。我们通过共同冲击的暴露来考虑企业间违约的相关性。系统性违约在经济衰退期间飙升，与宏观经济指标相关，并预测未来已实现的违约。更重要的是，它在样本内和样本外均预测未来的股票和公司债券指数收益。最后，我们发现平均股票收益的横截面与企业层面的系统性违约风险暴露相关。

articles.abstract_en: We use slow and fast time-series momentum to characterize four stock market cycles—Bull, Correction, Bear, and Rebound. The steep market declines of Bears concentrate in high-risk states, yet predict negative expected returns, which is difficult to rationalize by most models of time-varying risk premia. Using a model to analyze slow and fast momentum strategies, we estimate both relatively high mean persistence and realization noise in U.S. stock market returns. Intermediate-speed momentum portfolios, formed by blending slow and fast momentum strategies, translate predictive information in market cycles into positive unconditional alpha, for which we propose a novel decomposition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用慢速和快速时间序列动量来刻画四个股市周期——牛市、回调、熊市和反弹。熊市的急剧下跌集中在高风险状态，然而却预测负的预期收益，这难以用大多数时变风险溢价模型来合理化。通过使用一个模型分析慢速和快速动量策略，我们估计美国股市收益具有相对较高的均值持续性和实现噪声。通过混合慢速和快速动量策略形成的中间速度动量组合，将市场周期中的预测信息转化为正的无条件阿尔法，我们为此提出了一种新的分解方法。

articles.title_en: Index providers: Whales behind the scenes of ETFs
articles.title_cn: 指数提供商：ETF背后的鲸鱼
articles.abstract_en: Most ETFs replicate indexes licensed by index providers. We show that index providers wield strong market power and charge large markups to ETFs that are passed on to investors. We document three stylized facts: (i) the index provider market is highly concentrated; (ii) investors care about the identities of index providers, although they explain little variation in ETF returns; and (iii) over one-third of ETF expense ratios are paid as licensing fees to index providers. A structural decomposition attributes 60% of licensing fees to index providers’ markups. Counterfactual analyses show that improving competition among index providers reduces ETF expense ratios by up to 30%.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数ETF复制由指数提供商授权的指数。我们表明，指数提供商拥有强大的市场力量，并向ETF收取高额加价，这些成本转嫁给投资者。我们记录了三个典型事实：（i）指数提供商市场高度集中；（ii）投资者关注指数提供商的身份，尽管它们对ETF收益率的变动解释甚少；（iii）超过三分之一的ETF费用比率作为许可费支付给指数提供商。结构性分解将60%的许可费归因于指数提供商的加价。反事实分析表明，改善指数提供商之间的竞争可将ETF费用比率降低高达30%。

articles.title_cn: 多交易商平台的局限性
articles.abstract_en: On many important multi-dealer platforms, customers mostly request quotes from very few dealers. I build a model of multi-dealer platforms, where dealers strategically choose to respond to or ignore a request. If the customer contacts more dealers, each dealer responds with a lower probability and offers a stochastically worse price when responding. Dealers’ strategic avoidance of competition overturns the customer’s benefit from potentially receiving more quotes, worsening her best-overall price. In equilibrium, the customer contacts only two dealers. Multi-dealer platforms have limited ability to promote price competition: No design of information disclosure can improve the customer’s payoff above this outcome.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多重要的多交易商平台上，客户大多只向极少数交易商请求报价。我构建了一个多交易商平台模型，其中交易商策略性地选择回应或忽略请求。如果客户联系更多交易商，每个交易商回应的概率更低，且在回应时提供的价格随机性更差。交易商对竞争的策略性回避抵消了客户因可能获得更多报价而获得的收益，使其最优整体价格恶化。在均衡状态下，客户只联系两家交易商。多交易商平台促进价格竞争的能力有限：任何信息披露设计都无法将客户的收益提高到这一结果之上。

articles.title_en: Creditor rights, collateral reuse, and credit supply
articles.title_cn: 债权人权利、抵押品再利用与信贷供给
articles.abstract_en: Securities dealers receive mortgages as collateral for credit lines provided to mortgage companies and reuse the same collateral to borrow money. Exploiting the 2005 BAPCPA rule change, which granted mortgage collateral preferred bankruptcy treatment, I find that strengthening creditor rights increases dealers’ collateral reuse. Increasing collateral reuse creates a money multiplier that increases credit supply. Using a novel dataset linking dealers to the mortgage companies they fund reveals that post-BAPCPA, dealers supply additional credit to mortgage companies by increasing credit lines and relaxing restrictions on collateral securing them. In response, mortgage companies increase origination volume and shift into riskier products.
articles.abstract_cn: 证券交易商接受抵押贷款作为向抵押贷款公司提供信贷额度的抵押品，并再利用同一抵押品进行借款。利用2005年BAPCPA规则变更（该变更赋予抵押贷款抵押品优先破产待遇），我发现加强债权人权利会增加交易商的抵押品再利用。抵押品再利用的增加产生了货币乘数效应，从而增加了信贷供给。使用一个将交易商与其提供资金的抵押贷款公司联系起来的新数据集，结果显示，在BAPCPA之后，交易商通过增加信贷额度和放宽对其抵押品的限制，向抵押贷款公司提供额外信贷。作为回应，抵押贷款公司增加了贷款发放量，并转向风险更高的产品。

articles.title_en: A credit-based theory of the currency risk premium
articles.title_cn: 基于信用的货币风险溢价理论
articles.abstract_en: This paper uncovers a novel component for exchange rate predictability based on the price difference between sovereign credit default swaps denominated in different currencies. This new forecasting variable – the credit-implied risk premium – captures the expected currency depreciation conditional on a severe but rare credit event. Using data for 16 Eurozone countries, we find that the credit-implied risk premium positively forecasts the dollar-euro exchange rate return at various horizons. Moreover, a currency strategy that exploits the informative content of our predictor generates substantial out-of-sample economic value against the naïve random walk benchmark.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于不同货币计价的主权信用违约互换价格差异，揭示了汇率可预测性的一个新组成部分。这一新的预测变量——信用隐含风险溢价——捕捉了在严重但罕见的信用事件条件下预期的货币贬值。利用16个欧元区国家的数据，我们发现信用隐含风险溢价在不同时间跨度上正向预测美元兑欧元汇率回报。此外，利用我们预测变量信息内容的货币策略，相对于朴素随机游走基准，产生了显著的样本外经济价值。

articles.abstract_en: We investigate how the dynamics of corporate debt policy affect the pricing of corporate bonds. We find empirically that debt issuance has a significant stochastic component that is imperfectly correlated with shocks to asset value. As a consequence, the volatility of leverage is significantly higher than asset volatility over short horizons. At long horizons, the relation between leverage and asset volatility is reversed due to mean reversion in leverage. We incorporate these stochastic debt dynamics into structural models of credit risk, both standard diffusion models as well as newer models with stochastic volatility and jumps. Including stochastic debt gives more accurate predictions of credit spreads in both the cross-section and the time series.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了公司债务政策的动态如何影响公司债券的定价。我们实证发现，债务发行具有显著的随机成分，该成分与资产价值的冲击并非完全相关。因此，在短期内，杠杆的波动性显著高于资产波动性。在长期内，由于杠杆的均值回归，杠杆与资产波动性的关系发生逆转。我们将这些随机债务动态纳入信用风险的结构模型中，包括标准扩散模型以及具有随机波动率和跳跃的新模型。纳入随机债务在横截面和时间序列上都能更准确地预测信用利差。

articles.title_en: Collateral competition: Evidence from central counterparties
articles.title_cn: 抵押品竞争：来自中央对手方的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze competition and risk management at central counterparties (CCPs) using a granular transaction-level dataset, and find that CCPs decrease collateral in response to lower collateral at their competitors, an effect that becomes stronger as the correlation between positions increases. To interpret our findings, we derive a model in which collateral is driven by risk and CCP competition. Our results are consistent with the model and suggest that a single monopolistic CCP would require more collateral. We also show that amid the substantial increase in collateral during the Covid-19 pandemic, the probability of a margin breach did not significantly change.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个细粒度的交易级数据集分析中央对手方（CCPs）的竞争和风险管理，发现CCPs会因竞争对手的抵押品降低而减少自身抵押品，且当头寸之间的相关性增加时，这一效应会更强。为了解释我们的发现，我们构建了一个模型，其中抵押品由风险和CCP竞争驱动。我们的结果与模型一致，并表明一个垄断性的CCP将需要更多的抵押品。我们还表明，在Covid-19大流行期间抵押品大幅增加的情况下，保证金违约的概率并未显著变化。

articles.title_en: Deputizing financial institutions to fight elder abuse
articles.title_cn: 授权金融机构打击老年人虐待
articles.abstract_en: Permissive laws deputize financial professionals to screen for misbehavior without providing explicit incentives. These are very common in financial markets. To evaluate their effectiveness, we exploit the staggered adoption of the 2016 Model Act provisions intended to curb elder abuse. We find a drop in reports of abuse by financial professionals to the Department of Treasury and, separately, in financial crimes against the elderly as monitored by the FBI. The effect is stronger where the elderly are more isolated. Our results highlight the role financial professionals play in combating social problems and the impact of permissive policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 许可性法律授权金融专业人士筛查不当行为，但未提供明确激励。这类法律在金融市场中非常普遍。为评估其有效性，我们利用了旨在遏制老年人虐待的2016年《示范法》条款的分阶段实施。我们发现，金融专业人士向财政部报告的虐待事件有所下降，同时，联邦调查局监测的针对老年人的金融犯罪也有所减少。在老年人更为孤立的地方，这一效应更为显著。我们的结果凸显了金融专业人士在解决社会问题中所扮演的角色，以及许可性政策的影响。

articles.title_en: Fire sale risk and expected stock returns
articles.title_cn: 火售风险与预期股票收益
articles.abstract_en: We measure a stock’s exposure to fire sale risk through its ownership links to mutual funds that anticipate significant outflows during periods of systematic outflows from the fund industry. We find that stocks with higher exposure to this risk earn higher average returns: a portfolio that buys (shorts) stocks with the highest (lowest) exposure outperforms by 3-7% annually. Our findings cannot be explained by several known determinants of average returns and support the ex-ante pricing of the risk of fire sales. We conclude that stocks’ exposures to risks inherited from the constraints of shareholders have important implications for stock prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过股票与共同基金的所有权联系来衡量其对火售风险的暴露，这些基金在基金行业系统性流出期间预计会有大量流出。我们发现，暴露于该风险较高的股票获得较高的平均收益：买入（卖空）暴露最高（最低）的股票的投资组合每年跑赢3-7%。我们的发现无法由几个已知的平均收益决定因素解释，并支持火售风险的事前定价。我们得出结论，股票对股东约束所继承的风险的暴露对股票价格具有重要影响。
